canonical_name: Construction of the Ito stochastic integral
canonical_statement: On a filtered probability space carrying Brownian motion, the elementary adapted-process integral extends uniquely by the Ito isometry to square-integrable predictable integrands, agrees with the elementary finite-sum definition, and satisfies the L2 isometry.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: Omega : Type u; real time and real-valued Brownian motion; scalar integrands; Prop in a Lean universe determined by the chosen L2 model
quantifiers: a Brownian motion W adapted to the filtration
a square-integrable predictable real-valued integrand H
hypotheses: usual measurability/probability-space conditions required by the selected Brownian-motion API
conclusion: There exists a unique L2 stochastic integral agreeing with elementary adapted step sums and satisfying E[(integral H dW)^2] = E[integral H^2 dt].

alternate_encodings.target: terminal random variable in an L2 quotient

alternate_encodings.relationship: construction model expected to induce the L2 operator

excluded_degenerate_cases: T = 0 and zero integrand must reduce to zero; null-set representatives must not affect the result. General semimartingales, Stratonovich integrals, and locally square-integrable extensions are excluded.
foundation_profile: Classical real analysis, measure-theoretic quotients, and choice may be needed; exact rev-5.6 foundation profile remains open.
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel plus pinned mathlib; exact toolchain and transitive dependency closure remain open.
computation_profile: No native computation, oracle, or numerical evidence is credited at intake.
